chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Ajlan Abi Salih, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about devouring the wealth of the orphans, so he (peace be upon him) said: It is as Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has said: 'Indeed, those who devour the property of orphans unjustly are only devouring into their bellies fire, and they will be burned in a Blaze.'

Then he (peace be upon him) said, without me asking him: 'Whoever shelters an orphan until his orphanhood ceases or he becomes self-sufficient, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has obligated Paradise for him, just as He has obligated the Fire for the one who devours the wealth of the orphan.'

key_terms.أَكْلِ مَالِ الْيَتِيمِ: Devouring the wealth of the orphans

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for caring for an orphan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a direct thematic parallel between the grave sin of devouring orphans' wealth and the immense reward of their care, using the Quranic imagery of 'eating fire' to denote internalizing divine punishment. This narration underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the moral weight of guardianship (kafalah), framing the support of an orphan not merely as charity but as a guaranteed path to Paradise, mirroring the certainty of Hell for injustice.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Ajlan Abu Salih who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about devouring the wealth of the orphans, so heasws said: ‘It is as Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic has Said that [4:10] (As for) those who swallow the property of the orphans unjustly, but rather they only swallow fire into their bellies and they shall arriving at the Blazing Fire’.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> said without I having asked him<sup>asws</sup>: ‘The one who shelters an orphan until his orphan-hood is cut off, or he becomes self-sufficient, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would Obligate the Paradise for him just as He<sup>azwj</sup> Obligated the Fire for the one who devours the wealth of the orphans’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from ‘Ajlan abu Salih who has said the following: “

This is concerning my question before abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who consumes the properties of orphans. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is as Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, has said, “Those who consume the properties of orphans unjustly, they only consume fire in their bellies and will feel the heat of the fire.” [4:12]’

He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, then said without my asking, ‘Whoever provides an orphan until his condition as an orphan is over and becomes self-sufficient Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, makes paradise certain for him as He makes the fire definite for those who consume the properties of orphans.’”
